crossRefs.note: Yahweh said to Moses, “Take Joshua the son of Nun, a man in whom is the Spirit, and lay your hand on him.
Set him before Eleazar the priest, and before all the congregation; and commission him in their sight.
He laid his hands on him and commissioned him, as Yahweh spoke by Moses.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Behold, your days approach that you must die. Call Joshua, and present yourselves in the Tent of…
He commissioned Joshua the son of Nun, and said, “Be strong and courageous; for you shall bring the children of Israel…
Jesus came to them and spoke to them, saying, “All authority has been given to me in heaven and on earth.
until the day in which he was received up, after he had given commandment through the Holy Spirit to the apostles whom…
“Now, behold, I know that you all, among whom I went about preaching God’s Kingdom, will see my face no more.
I command you in the sight of God, and the Lord Jesus Christ, and the chosen angels, that you observe these things…
I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and before Christ Jesus, who before Pontius Pilate testified…
I command you therefore before God and the Lord Jesus Christ, who will judge the living and the dead at his appearing…

parallels.note: So Solomon built the house, and finished it.

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Then he called for Solomon his son, and commanded him to build a house for Yahweh, the God of Israel.
translations.bsb: Then David called for his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the LORD, the God of Israel.
translations.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the LORD God of Israel.
translations.asv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build a house for Jehovah, the God of Israel.
